title: Hour-Aware Adaptive Risk Management for Autonomous Memecoin Trading on Solana DEXs: Evidence, Theory, and Design Lessons from a 15-Day Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2606.08232v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We report a 15-day paper-traded autonomous memecoin trading deployment on Solana decentralised exchanges (DEXs), designed as a controlled measurement of three microstructure questions on which classical equity theory offers well-defined predictions but on which the AMM Solana venue lacks published measurement: (i) time-of-day return patterns on a 24/7 permissionless venue; (ii) whether decision-time filter stacks are net-positive against counterfactual returns of rejected tokens; (iii) whether small-sample cumulative-return statistics on a heavy-tailed venue are structurally robust or fragile. The 190-trade sample (March 29 to April 12, 2026) shows a 40.5 percent win rate, mean per-trade return +0.62 percent, cumulative +117.7 percent, skewness -1.21, excess kurtosis 6.61. Mann-Whitney U on three exploratorily identified worst entry hours (n=17, mean -11.60 percent) versus all others (n=173, mean +1.82 percent) yields p = 0.5634; dir

translated_title: 面向Solana去中心化交易所自主迷因币交易的时段感知自适应风险管理：来自15天部署的证据、理论与设计经验
translated_abstract: 我们报告了在Solana去中心化交易所（DEX）上为期15天的模拟盘自主迷因币交易部署，该部署被设计为一项对照测量，针对三个经典股票市场理论有明确预测、但基于AMM的Solana交易场所缺乏公开测量的微观结构问题：(i) 24/7全天候无许可场所的日内时段收益模式；(ii) 决策时过滤器堆栈相对于被拒代币的反事实收益是否净为正；(iii) 厚尾场所上的小样本累计收益统计在结构上是稳健还是脆弱。190笔交易的样本（2026年3月29日至4月12日）显示胜率为40.5%、单笔平均收益+0.62%、累计收益+117.7%、偏度为-1.21、超额峰度为6.61。对探索性识别出的三个最差入场时段（n=17，均值-11.60%）与所有其他时段（n=173，均值+1.82%）进行的Mann-Whitney U检验得到p = 0.5634；dir（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过在Solana去中心化交易所上进行的15天自主迷因币模拟交易部署（190笔交易，累计收益+117.7%），实证检验了24/7无许可交易场所的日内时段收益模式、过滤器堆栈的有效性以及小样本累计收益统计的稳健性这三个微观结构问题。
en_tdlr: Through a 15-day autonomous memecoin paper-trading deployment on Solana DEXs (190 trades, +117.7% cumulative return), this paper empirically examines three microstructure questions: intraday return patterns on a 24/7 permissionless venue, the net effectiveness of decision-time filter stacks, and the robustness of small-sample cumulative-return statistics on heavy-tailed venues.
